user.title: Panel identity
user.description: Name this panel and enter the Zigbee2MQTT device name/prefix (example: {prefix_hint}). Auto mode maps L1–L4, names, colors, radar, backlight, and child lock from that prefix.

relays.title: Relay entities
relays.description: Confirm the four switch entities used as physical buttons. Auto-fill may leave gaps: {missing}

names.title: Name entities
names.description: Select the four text entities that show button labels on the panel.

settings.title: Shared settings
settings.description: Select color, radar, backlight, and child-lock entities.

summary.title: Validation summary
summary.description: Mapping validated for {panel_name}. Confirm to create the panel.

error.prefix_not_found: Could not find L1–L4 switches for that device prefix. Check the Zigbee2MQTT name or switch to manual mapping.

abort.already_configured: This relay set is already configured.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Sync the active profile draft to the physical panel.

activate_profile.name: Activate profile
activate_profile.description: Activate a profile, optionally syncing immediately.

pull_from_panel.name: Pull from panel
pull_from_panel.description: Pull current hardware values into the active profile draft.

execute_button.name: Execute button
execute_button.description: Execute a button action without a physical press.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload one or all ConX Dynamic Panel entries.
